<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that forms a sulfonamide (S‑N bond) in the forward direction. Using the functional groups list, we can search for templates that form a “sulfonamides” group and break “acyl chloride” (sulfonyl chloride) and “primary amines”. We also specify the formed bond as S‑N using atomic numbers 16‑7. The target molecule is benzenesulfonamide (SMILES C1=CC=C(C=C1)S(=O)(=O)N). We'll request up to 10 matching templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C1=CC=C(C=C1)S(=O)(=O)N",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
    "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride", "primary amines"],
    "bonds_formed": ["16-7"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
